_comment: Granite board pipeline: generated MATERIAL textures + piece sheets (ComfyUI), procedural compositor for the board (tools/assetgen/compose_granite.py). Edit prompts freely.
negative: text, watermark, logo, signature, people, hands, cartoon, illustration, painting, 3d render, blurry, low quality, jpeg artifacts

granite_base.prompt: top-down macro photograph of a polished slab of uniform near-black granite, extremely fine and sparse tiny gold and white mineral specks scattered evenly, subtle fine grain, smooth finish, flat even diffuse lighting, no shadows, highly detailed, photo of black galaxy granite countertop
granite_base.negative_extra: large gold flakes, gold nuggets, gravel, pebbles, rocks, coarse crystals, grey, brown, pink, white patches, reflections, glare, border, perspective, scratches, cracks

chisel.prompt: top-down macro photograph of rough hand-chiselled light grey-beige granite stone surface, visible chisel tool marks, coarse sandy grain, dusty, matte, flat even diffuse lighting, no shadows, highly detailed
chisel.negative_extra: dark, black, polished, shiny, wet, cracks, perspective, border, colour cast

table.prompt: top-down photograph of a rustic dark wooden plank table, weathered reclaimed oak boards, deep grain, scratches and knots, warm golden hour light, rich dark brown tones, empty, no objects, highly detailed
table.negative_extra: objects, plates, people, bright colours, perspective, horizon, glare, text

sheet_p1.prompt: top-down studio product photo of eight round polished red jasper cabochons, flat domed, brick red and oxblood with natural darker brown-red veins and mottling, evenly spaced in two rows of four, every stone fully separate with generous gaps, on a plain flat matte medium grey background, soft warm light from the upper left, sharp focus
sheet_p1.negative_extra: touching stones, overlapping, hands, jewelry setting, ring, necklace, text, reflections of objects, dark background, shadows on background

sheet_p2.prompt: top-down studio product photo of eight round polished lapis lazuli cabochons, flat domed, deep royal blue with fine gold pyrite flecks and a few white calcite veins, arranged in two evenly spaced rows of four, every stone fully separate with generous gaps, on a plain flat matte medium grey background, soft warm light from the upper left, sharp focus
sheet_p2.negative_extra: touching stones, overlapping, hands, jewelry setting, ring, necklace, text, reflections of objects, dark background, shadows on background

stone_p1.prompt: a single polished red jasper, round polished cabochon centred in the frame filling about 70% of the image, top-down view, flat dome, studio product photo, plain flat matte neutral grey background, soft key light from the upper left with one small clean specular highlight at the upper left of the stone, no cast shadow, sharp focus, brick and oxblood red with natural darker veins and banding
